meta.source: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, TradeStat (DGCI&S customs data)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each month is printed final (F) in its own month's table and revised final (R) in the table a year later; principal-commodity quick estimates are provisional (P). Every value carries its flag in meta.revision.
meta.coverage: What India sells to each partner, by HS chapter: every partner x every chapter traded, each financial year since 2016-17, US$ million
meta.note: TradeStat MEIDB country-wise all-commodities tables, March calls (April-to-March cumulatives; R from the following March where it exists). Only pairs with trade are listed: a missing pair traded nothing that year (TradeStat prints no line for it).
